name: movscript
description: MovScript project, script, path-based workspace projection, media query, and generation tools backed by the frontend MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Use MovScript projects, scripts, projection paths, media queries, and generation.
interface.longDescription: Installs MovScript project/script/workspace guidance and connects to the MovScript frontend MCP server. The MCP bridge exposes current focus, project listing and creation, script listing, script passage location, path-based workspace projection refresh/review/apply, project queries, MovScript resource-library search, shot-library search, external media search, model discovery, image generation, video generation, job polling, and candidate attachment.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use MovScript's MCP tools for current focus, project/script context, resource-library lookup, shot-library search, external media search, model discovery, image/video generation, and path-based workspace projection edits. Treat generation input_resource_ids/reference_resource_ids as MovScript RawResource IDs only. For workspace changes, edit the local projection path, run workspace_apply_review(path), then workspace_apply(path); if path is omitted, MovScript maps cwd/current focus to the projection folder. Use workspace_update(path) only to refresh from backend and overwrite local changes. Projection paths include workspace JSON files, project.json, script.md, and the read-only global projects.index.json.
